name: No. Series Manager
brief: Create date-based No. Series Lines (week, month, quarter, year) ahead of time from a pattern.
description: No. Series Manager keeps period-based number series ready. Define a pattern such as INV-YYMM- or YYQQ per number series, choose week (ISO), month, quarter or year, and let a batch job create or update the No. Series Lines for the coming periods, with the starting, ending and warning numbers, increment and implementation you set, so posting never stops for a missing line.
